actual_scope: Prove exact five-site residual-phase and rank rigidity for the fixed T740 owner-0/port-0 word at children 8,10,12,13,14, including one partially hosted donor.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first selection follows PR3263's explicit one-donor question after rank-only candidates failed exact operator replay. PR3199/3204 already cover four fully idle sites. This package adds the pinned partially hosted child 14, a complete all-character symbolic matrix and an independent source reconstruction; it does not repeat moment arithmetic or candidate-specific counterexamples.
bottleneck_link: A moment decrease is unusable when moving axes changes the data operator. The exact five-site criterion rules out rank-profile improvements in this named domain before further allocation optimization, while preserving changed-site and changed-contract alternatives.
stop_rule: Within 60 minutes, retain a written source-bound operator constraint and independently reconstructed finite symbolic certificate, or identify the exact remaining character-algebra obligation. Do not infer all-character equality from coordinate samples, expand to additional donors or run a new rank-only moment search.
evidence: Both implementations reconstruct the pinned owner-0/port-0 context and derive the same normalized 8x8 matrix: 16 final formal terms, peak 21, and zero remaining dependence on the 73 character bits. Five diagonal entries force all five phase multipliers to one; all 1,024 fourth-root assignments give exactly one identity. A uniform-character average proves unchanged ranks for independent residual bases: 48,48,48,48,1. The independent implementation imports neither primary nor predecessor executable. Six controls pass on CPython 3.12.15 in isolated optimized mode, including a quadratic phase invisible on coordinate characters, distinct orthonormal same-phase bases, explicit Gaussian specialization, actual donor axis 2^72 removal against numeric source replay, omitted hosted/bridge actions and source-byte corruption. No native/all-width, global allocation, selected cold replay or human/formal review. The complete registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes primary, independent and isolated optimized failure controls.
